- Checking the Sierra Entertainment catalog (Passage [3] and surrounding context), there is no evidence that *F.E.A.R.* was published under the Sierra label. Hoyle's Official Book of Games | Hoyle's Official Book of Games (or Hoyle Series or Hoyle Games) is a series of games produced by Sierra Entertainment.
